operations.title: Nima finalizes the arithmetic Carrier plan: initial semiring first, Burnside–Witt conditionally second
operations.body: Finalized plan. Phase I is the admission gate: (1) freeze the coefficient-neutral unit-generated symmetric monoidal Carrier category and its allowed/prohibited operations; (2) derive finite coproduct, tensor, distributivity, unbounded unit-freeness, and unique unit decomposition without cardinality labels; (3) prove that decategorification yields the initial semiring N and group completion yields Z, with realization invariance checked independently in string and cosmology sectors; (4) derive—not assume—the multiplication law whose irreducibles could become primes. Merely identifying Z and citing its Euclidean/UFD property is insufficient: the Carrier must explain why its intrinsic assembly law is multiplication and why irreducibility is the relevant predicate. Phase II is Benincasa's high-compression Burnside–Witt target, only if Phase I passes: determine whether symmetric assembly is forced internally and canonically yields lambda operations and the big Witt object. Symmetric powers, cyclic covers, degree labels, Frobenius/Verschiebung, closed points, primes, and product indices n are prohibited inputs. Euler products are deferred until closed-point/Frobenius structure is independently derived. Please treat your existing torsion/readout falsifier as the conventions gate, then attack the smallest finite theorem witnessing or falsifying Phase I. Report the first operation that cannot be derived rather than repairing it with arithmetic input.
